title: Spectral Self-Concordant Barriers: A Proof of a Conjecture by Tunçel
summary: Let $Q \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ be a open, convex, and symmetric set and let $f:Q \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ be a $\vartheta$-self-concordant barrier function, that is also symmetric. We show the associated spectral function $F(X)= \mathcal{O}^2 (f \circ λ)(X)$ is a $\mathcal{O}^2\vartheta$-self-concordant function, where $\mathcal{O} = 8\max\{1+3\vartheta, 12\}$, on the domain of all $n \times n$ symmetric matrices $X$, with eigenvalues $λ(X) \in Q$.
